evidence_quotes.agenda: Let's talk about your move. What are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer's answer to the agenda question was an inventory rundown (bed, sofa, TV unmount, boxes), not a concern needing follow-up -- judgment call: graded as no-concern-raised (full credit) rather than shallow.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: once we go over the minimum, the time is per rated in fifteen minute increments -- covered; but no dollar estimate for total hours was ever given, so the window/fairness-check lines had nothing concrete to anchor to.

top_strength: Textbook quid pro quo opener -- exact script match ('Let's start with a few questions...this call should take around ten to fifteen minutes...then we'll be able to build you an accurate quote') plus the agenda question asked before any probing.
coaching_note: Never delivered an actual anchor-then-personalize hour/dollar estimate (only explained the hourly rate mechanics) and the call ended with 'we will definitely be in contact' -- no explicit ask to book and nothing scheduled.
